question.title: Telemetry capture
question.question: Which characters are actually legible, and which information must remain unknown? Focus on the “Telemetry capture” screen.

request.systemPrompt:
You are the vision subsystem of a web-automation agent. A screenshot of the current browser viewport is attached. Describe what is on screen so the planning agent can decide its next action.

Format — keep it terse, structured, no flowery prose:

1) Page purpose: one line (e.g. "GitHub repo issue list", "Gmail compose", "Stripe checkout form").
2) Visible text: list the EXACT strings on buttons, links, headings, tabs, and menu items. Quote them verbatim. Do not paraphrase.
3) Inputs: list each visible form field with its label, placeholder, current value, and whether it is focused/disabled.
4) State signals: loading spinners, toasts, modals, error banners, success messages, CAPTCHAs, cookie/consent banners, overlays.
5) Blockers: anything that would prevent the next likely action (overlay, disabled submit, missing data, auth prompt).
6) Unknowns: if you cannot read something clearly, say so. Do not guess numbers, names, or identifiers.

Rules: no prose intro, no conclusion, no "this screenshot shows...", no layout description unless it matters (e.g. "left nav is collapsed"). If the page is blank or still loading, say that in one line and stop.
request.userText: Describe this screenshot of the current browser viewport for a web-automation agent. Follow the format in the system prompt.

response.content:
1) Page purpose: Document viewer showing a "Telemetry capture" document within a WebScene app.

2) Visible text:
- Top nav: "WebScene", "Home", "Workspace", "Activity"
- Eyebrow: "DOCUMENT VIEWER"
- Heading: "Telemetry capture"
- Row label: "Runtime target"
- Row value (monospace): "Node ••7? / region eu-?"
- Warning banner: "node and region identifiers are partially unreadable" (preceded by a blurred/illegible short string)
- Right sidebar: "Page 1 of 1", "125%"

3) Inputs: None visible. No form fields, no focused elements.

4) State signals:
- Yellow/amber warning banner with italic orange text: "node and region identifiers are partially unreadable"
- Blurred/redacted text in the banner's left area and partially masked node/region value ("••7?", "eu-?") — data appears intentionally obscured or degraded
- Body content below the banner rendered as gray placeholder/skeleton bars (7 bars of varying widths), suggesting content not loaded or redacted
- Green circular avatar button, top right (no label)

5) Blockers:
- Node and region identifiers are partially unreadable — cannot reliably read exact node/region values
- Document body is placeholder bars only; no actionable content, links, or buttons in the document area
- No visible controls (zoom, next page, download) beyond the "125%" / "Page 1 of 1" text

6) Unknowns:
- Exact node identifier (only "••7?" visible) and region (only "eu-?" visible)
- Blurred string at the start of the warning banner — illegible
- Whether the gray bars are loading placeholders or permanently redacted content
- Whether "125%" is a static label or a clickable zoom control
